sections.title: Analysis summary
sections.text: Research analysis with corovision-preserved-2d-20261023. preprocessing: completed. artery segmentation: review required. vessel analysis: review required. stenosis detection: review required. severity assessment: blocked.

sections.title: Artery segmentation
sections.text: The model predicted 8927 artery-mask pixels in the prepared image. The mask requires image review; prediction alone does not establish anatomical correctness.

sections.title: Vessel structure
sections.text: Centerlines and diameter/length estimates derive from the predicted 2D mask. Use the recorded units; projection and segmentation errors affect these estimates.

sections.title: Stenosis candidates
sections.text: The mask model returned 1 candidate instance(s). Scores are raw model outputs, not calibrated patient disease probabilities.

sections.title: Severity assessment
sections.text: Not assessed — insufficient evidence. A validated candidate-local diameter and reference-segment protocol is unavailable.

sections.title: Evidence and limitations
sections.text: Validation metrics describe their recorded dataset/split and aggregation, not accuracy on this image. A human assessment is separate from these model and algorithm outputs. Research output; not a standalone diagnosis. Raw scores are not calibrated patient confidence. No detections do not establish absence of disease. No validated automatic severity or vessel-segment association. 2D projection and preprocessing can change measurement reliability.
